summary: Phase 3 adversarial re-audit at fa85bb2a: Red closed ADV-5 and ADV-6 exactly as routed, and every probe is now caught or passes as designed. The fix diff 6cc6f91f..fa85bb2a touches only measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-rework.sh (+24 lines) and red-p3.log (+21 lines, the Red result entry). The ADV-5 fix adds a P3-a check that fails 'rework commit [...] touches none of its source_paths; the claimed source change is not in git' whenever git show --name-only on the commit is empty for every source_paths entry. The ADV-6 fix adds a P3-c check that fails 'rerate audited_head [...] predates the rework commit [...]; the judge saw the old shots' unless the rework commit is an ancestor of the audited_head. Re-audit run: adversarial-p3.sh exits 0. The control gate no longer hardcodes a total: it parses the live checker total from the committed-tree run (41) and requires the faithful git fixture to pass 41 of 41, which it does. Probe results: ADV-P3-01 (rework commit that touches only the shots and a stray file) now FAILs exit 1 with the exact ADV-5 line, so ADV-5 is closed; ADV-P3-03 (rerate audited_head set to the phase-base commit that predates the rework) now FAILs exit 1 with the exact ADV-6 line, so ADV-6 is closed; ADV-P3-02 (side-branch commit) fails with 5 FAILs, now also triggering both new checks (the side commit touches no source and the audited_head no longer descends from it); ADV-P3-04 (log model_id glm-5.3 against the route kimi-for-coding) still fails the exact compare; ADV-P3-05 (a rework record for bank, judge 7.5, critical false, rated) still fails with 4 FAILs led by 'reworked map bank is not below the bar'; ADV-P3-06 (inventory Rerate 5.0 against the record 7.5) still fails the P3-e compare; ADV-P3-07 (accepted with critical true) still fails 'wants state [follow-up]'; ADV-P3-08 boundary stays exact with el 45.0 and 50.0 passing 41 of 41 and 44.9 failing 'lies outside [45, 50]'. The committed tree gate passes === Total: 41 checks (PASS=41, FAIL=0) ===. No blocking finding, no violation, and no residual gap remains from the first adversarial run.
